'''Protocol five''' was a protocol order issued by [[Iaclyn Stark]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] to the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on the [[Eclipse station (Reltooine)|Eclipse Station]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent [[Jahan Cross]].
